outcome.answer: You can judge these reports automatically by using a reusable rubric-based evaluator built from trusted news-assessment questions and expected short answers. One paper describes creating importance-weighted rubrics for 30 news articles and then using an automated process, AutoJudge, to score new report-generation runs against those rubrics, with strong agreement with human evaluation [1]. Another paper describes a similar task pipeline for generating trustworthiness reports, where retrieved evidence is synthesized into concise cited reports and judged on official evaluation [2].
